title: 第21章 柳依依 我不干净了第22章 小姨子你能帮我追你姐吗
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
“诛！”
一字落下。
全国各地无数地方，但凡是赵荣三代血亲全部被一团火焰笼罩，在极致痛苦中离世。
赵荣感到刺骨钻心的痛苦，默默流出两行血泪，一团妖艳如血的火焰将他慢慢吞没。
可赵荣。
感觉不到任何痛，他的心已经死了。
……
王宗依旧跪在地上，整个人抖若筛糠。
他慌了。
他甚至开始怀疑眼前的叶前辈究竟是不是武宗强者，这以血咒杀的手段简直闻所未闻。
而且……
叶前辈杀伐之气太重。
他所熟知的那几位武宗，无不是慈眉善目以和为贵。
王宗头顶突然响起一道声音：“抬起头。”
王宗只得小心翼翼抬起头。
叶凡浑不在意道：“你似乎对我有意见，觉得我是邪修，手段过于残忍。”
王宗急了：“前辈，晚辈绝对不会这么想，只觉得您杀的好，替天行道为民除害，还了这东海市一片朗朗乾坤，晚辈将会用余生所有时间来学习您的侠义精神。”
“哦？”
叶凡来了兴趣：“仔细说说，怎样的侠义精神。”
“为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平。”

“这是多少修行之人的初衷，你做到了么。”
“……”
王宗沉默了。
叶凡顿时失了兴趣。
他拦腰抱起柳依依，从满地鲜血的三楼走到已经空荡荡的二楼，又从二楼走到同样空荡荡的一楼。
酒吧外倒是有不少人围观，他们听说里面死了人，举起手机疯狂拍照。
“有人出来了。”
随着叶凡出现，手机镜头聚焦开始拍照录像，只是这些手机一个个全部爆碎开来。
叶前辈不喜欢出头露面。
跟在叶凡身后的王宗瞬间明悟了这一点，下定决心将刚才看到的事全部吞到肚子里，直至带进棺材。
没有直接带柳依依回家，而是进了酒吧旁边的酒店，倒不是叶凡有什么非分之想。
content_en:
"Execute!"
One word fell.
In countless places across the country, all three generations of Zhao Rong's blood relatives were enveloped in a ball of flames and died in extreme pain.
Zhao Rong felt the heart-piercing pain, and silently shed two lines of blood tears, and a ball of enchanting flames like blood slowly engulfed him.
But Zhao Rong.
He couldn't feel any pain, his heart was dead.
…
Wang Zong was still kneeling on the ground, his whole body shaking like chaff.
He panicked.
He even began to doubt whether the senior Ye in front of him was a powerful martial artist. This method of killing with a blood curse was simply unheard of.
And...
Senior Ye's murderous spirit is too strong.
The martial sects he knew well were all kind-hearted and valued peace.
A voice suddenly sounded above Wang Zong's head: "Raise your head."
Wang Zong could only raise his head cautiously.
Ye Fanhun said nonchalantly: "You seem to have a problem with me. You think I am an evil cultivator and my methods are too cruel."
Wang Zong was anxious: "Senior, this junior will never think so. I only think that you killed well, did justice for heaven and the people, and restored a bright future to Donghai City. This junior will spend the rest of his life learning your chivalrous spirit."
"Oh?"
Ye Fan became interested: "Tell me carefully, what kind of chivalrous spirit you have."
"Establish a mind for the heaven and earth, establish a destiny for the living people, carry forward the unique teachings of the past saints, and create peace for all generations."
"This is the original intention of many practitioners. Have you achieved it?"
"..."
Wang Zong was silent.
Ye Fan suddenly lost interest.
He picked up Liu Yiyi from the waist and walked from the third floor, which was covered in blood, to the empty second floor, and then from the second floor to the equally empty first floor.
There were quite a few people watching outside the bar. They heard that someone had died inside, and they raised their phones to take photos frantically.
"Someone's out."
As Ye Fan appeared, the cell phone lenses focused and began to take photos and videos, but all these cell phones exploded one by one.
Senior Ye doesn't like to appear in public.
Wang Zong, who was following Ye Fan, understood this instantly and made up his mind to swallow everything he just saw until he took it into the coffin.
Instead of taking Liu Yiyi home directly, he went into the hotel next to the bar. It wasn't that Ye Fan had any wrong ideas.
